result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.trav_out()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Traverse from selected nodes to outward neighbors. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L6445-L6479){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.trav_out() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} From the currently selected nodes, moves to all nodes that can be reached by following outward edges (where selected nodes are sources). The current node selection is replaced with the traversed nodes. For directed graphs, follows edges in the forward direction. For undirected graphs, follows edges in all directions (equivalent to `trav_both()`). ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#387e3b81 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph(directed=True) graph.add_node("A").add_node("B").add_node("C") graph.add_edge("A", "B") graph.add_edge("B", "C") node_a_id = graph.get_id_from_label("A") graph.select_nodes_by_id([node_a_id]).trav_out() selected = graph.get_selected_node_ids() # Returns [node_id_for_B] ``` :::
